metas.name: Ask the StoryBots
metas.description: Similar to Ada Twist, Scientist and The Magic School Bus, this show uses engaging animation and catchy songs to answer kids' big questions about how the world works, with a focus on science and technology.

metas.name: Wild Kratts
metas.description: For fans of The Magic School Bus and WordGirl, this animated series follows two brothers who travel the world to learn about animals and their amazing abilities, blending education with adventure.

metas.name: Octonauts
metas.description: If they enjoy the problem-solving and teamwork of Doc McStuffins and the educational aspect of Curious George, they'll love the Octonauts who explore the ocean and rescue sea creatures.

metas.name: Sarah & Duck
metas.description: This gentle and whimsical animated show shares the quiet curiosity and imaginative play found in Bluey and Curious George, with a focus on simple, everyday adventures.

metas.name: Sid the Science Kid
metas.description: A great follow-up to Ada Twist, Scientist and Numberblocks, this live-action/animated hybrid encourages children to ask 'why' and explore scientific concepts through everyday experiences.

metas.name: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
metas.description: Similar to Doc McStuffins in its focus on social-emotional learning and life lessons, this animated series uses songs and relatable situations to teach preschoolers about feelings and cooperation.

metas.name: Sesame Street
metas.description: A classic educational program that parallels the learning of Numberblocks and Peg + Cat, incorporating songs, games, and friendly characters to teach letters, numbers, and social skills.

metas.name: Tumble Leaf
metas.description: With the same gentle pacing and focus on exploration as Curious George and Bluey, this stop-motion animated series follows a curious fox named Fig and his friends as they discover the natural world.

metas.name: Super Why!
metas.description: Combines literacy and problem-solving, much like WordGirl and Peg + Cat, where characters enter storybooks to find answers to their problems by reading words and letters.

metas.name: Puffin Rock
metas.description: A beautifully animated and calming series that shares the nature focus of Curious George and the gentle storytelling of Bluey, following two young puffins and their adventures on an Irish island.

metas.name: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
metas.description: Like The Magic School Bus, this show uses fun adventures with the iconic Cat in the Hat to explore scientific concepts for young children.

metas.name: Ready Jet Go!
metas.description: This animated series is perfect for those who enjoyed Ada Twist, Scientist and The Magic School Bus, as it focuses on space exploration and scientific discovery with a group of neighborhood kids.

metas.name: Leo the Wildlife Ranger
metas.description: Similar to Wild Kratts in its focus on animals, this animated show follows Leo as he travels the world to learn about different species and habitats, promoting conservation awareness.

metas.name: Molly of Denali
metas.description: This educational series blends animated and live-action segments, focusing on Alaskan Native culture and featuring problem-solving that might appeal to fans of Special Agent Oso and WordGirl.

metas.name: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
metas.description: A fun and educational show that allows kids to travel back in time to meet historical figures, akin to the learning adventures in The Magic School Bus and Ask the StoryBots.

metas.name: Alma's Way
metas.description: This animated series celebrates Dominican and Puerto Rican culture and focuses on problem-solving and critical thinking, with a similar warmth and community feel to Bluey and Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood.

metas.name: Trash Truck
metas.description: A gentle and charming animated series about the friendship between a boy and his trash truck, with the heartwarming simplicity and exploration of everyday life found in Curious George and Bluey.

metas.name: Ollie & Moon Show
metas.description: This animated show follows two feline friends on adventures around the world, introducing children to different cultures and environments in a fun and engaging way, similar to the spirit of Curious George.

metas.name: Emily's Wonder Lab
metas.description: A live-action science show with experiments that kids can try at home, similar to the hands-on learning of The Magic School Bus and Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: Guess with Jess
metas.description: A gentle animated series where a cat and her friends go on adventures and ask questions, fostering curiosity and problem-solving skills similar to Peg + Cat and Curious George.

metas.name: Rosie's Rules
metas.description: This animated show focuses on a young girl in a bilingual household, teaching about family, community, and learning new things, with the relatable characters and gentle lessons of Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood.

metas.name: Kazoops
metas.description: An animated series that explores children's questions about the world through music and imaginative adventures, mirroring the inquisitive nature of Ada Twist, Scientist and Peg + Cat.

metas.name: The Wombles
metas.description: A classic family series about creatures who tidy up the environment, promoting ecological awareness and problem-solving in a charming and gentle way, appealing to the spirit of curiosity found in Curious George.

metas.name: If You Give a Mouse a Cookie
metas.description: Based on beloved books, this animated series features short, interconnected stories that encourage imaginative thinking and problem-solving, with a whimsical feel similar to Bluey and Curious George.

metas.name: Elinor Wonders Why
metas.description: This animated show encourages observation and inquiry about the natural world, with a gentle and curious tone that will resonate with fans of Curious George and Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: Pip and Posy
metas.description: A charming animated series about the friendship and everyday adventures of a mouse and a rabbit, focusing on themes of friendship, sharing, and problem-solving, similar to Bluey and Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood.

metas.name: Rhyme Time Town
metas.description: This animated preschool show uses songs and rhymes to teach early literacy and problem-solving skills, a fun and engaging approach for fans of Peg + Cat and WordGirl.

metas.name: Chuggington
metas.description: An animated series about young trains learning important lessons about teamwork, responsibility, and problem-solving, with a focus on daily routines and tasks that might appeal to fans of Special Agent Oso.

metas.name: Pocoyo
metas.description: A visually distinct animated series with minimal dialogue, focusing on simple adventures and learning concepts through observation and interaction, similar to the gentle discovery in Curious George and Bluey.

metas.name: Creative Galaxy
metas.description: This animated show encourages creativity and artistic exploration by following a young artist on imaginative adventures, appealing to the inventive spirit of Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: The Fixies
metas.description: An animated series where tiny creatures live inside machines and help fix them, explaining how everyday objects work in an accessible and entertaining way, perfect for fans of Ada Twist, Scientist and The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Blippi
metas.description: A popular live-action show where Blippi visits exciting places and explores educational topics, engaging children with enthusiastic energy, similar to the curiosity-driven learning of Curious George and Special Agent Oso.

metas.name: Dino Dana
metas.description: A live-action/animated hybrid series where a girl uses augmented reality to interact with dinosaurs, blending scientific curiosity with imaginative play, akin to The Magic School Bus and Wild Kratts.
